mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile: it showed how local electrical changes can pass a message along without one ion traveling the whole distance.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the insulating cells was less engaging because it was the only combination offered and mostly set up the wrapping step.

surprise.text: I was surprised that other living cells wrap their membranes around sections of one nerve cell's long extension.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless, although the wrapping's effect on message speed wasn't clear until the result, and its mechanism remains unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these nerve messages connect to muscles, though the mostly forced choices make me less curious about the combinations themselves.
